population.intervention: Immediate tailored self-guided interactive digital cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (Bedtime Window) or digital sleep education control.
population.intervention_regimen: CBTi: planned 5 × 20-minute online sessions over 5 consecutive weeks; control: 5 weekly digital sleep education packets during the first 5 weeks; control offered CBTi after 8-week follow-up.
population.population_definition: Randomized treatment assignment (1:1) to immediate tailored digital CBTi vs digital sleep education; primary ITT sample; Adults aged ≥18 years with a self-reported doctor diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnoea and Insomnia Severity Index (ISI) ≥15, randomized 1:1. Exclusions: bipolar disorder; schizophrenia; epilepsy; pregnancy; PHQ-9 item 9 score ≥1; Epworth Sleepiness Scale score ≥16; current shift work; operating heavy machinery or driving for work; previous diagnosis of cognitive impairment; doctor diagnosis of any sleep disorder other than insomnia or OSA; previous sleepiness-related motor vehicle accident.
population.population_name: Primary intention-to-treat population of adults with COMISA (both randomized arms)
population.population_time_frame: Recruited September 2022 to May 2023 (paper); ANZCTR reports actual first participant enrolment 23/09/2022 and actual last participant enrolment 16/05/2024; questionnaire assessments at baseline and 8 weeks post-randomisation for this task.
